name: WEUSD
oneLiner: WEUSD is PicWe's omni-chain USDT wrapper minted and redeemed 1:1 against USDT; the token has been trading off-peg near $0.91 despite documented backing.
collateral: 100% USDT-backed omni-chain stablecoin according to PicWe documentation; future RWA/yield collateral is described as roadmap rather than current backing
pegMechanism: PicWe mint/redeem flow issues WEUSD against USDT and supports on-chain redemption back to USDT with a documented redemption fee.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: WEUSD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

notices.title: Active depeg
notices.message: WEUSD has been trading near $0.91 despite documented 1:1 USDT backing; redemption pipeline may be impaired.

mintAuthority.summary: WEUSD is minted and redeemed through PicWe's omni-chain protocol via an AccessControl token whose MINTER_ROLE is held by PicWe's mint/redeem contract; minting is permissioned to the issuer, and the basket-style backing (roughly 9 USDT + 1 MOVE) explains the persistent ~$0.91 trading level.

controls.label: PicWe WEUSD MINTER_ROLE / mint-redeem contract
controls.evidence: BscScan shows the WEUSD token uses OpenZeppelin AccessControl with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and a MINTER_ROLE-gated mint(address,uint256); the deployer 0xc12233455beac4e094a5de022be692a264c0c0bc initially holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and can grant the MINTER_ROLE, and PicWe docs name a dedicated mint/redeem contract (0x5D54f1092FD1750A3ab96972dc1867c5B23eF22C) as the issuance handler.

review.evidence: WEUSD is PicWe's omni-chain settlement currency minted/redeemed via PicWe's protocol; the token contract is OpenZeppelin AccessControl with a MINTER_ROLE gating mint, and the basket economic model (about 9 USDT + 1 MOVE per 10 WEUSD) is the documented reason for the sub-$1 floor rather than a pure 1:1 USDT wrapper.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the current MINTER_ROLE holder address(es) via RoleGranted logs and whether DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by an EOA, multisig, or Safe.
